info.name: GitHub Get the Audit Log for an Organization

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: phrase
params.description: A search phrase. For more information, see [Searching the audit log](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/github/setting-up-and-managing-organizations-and-teams/reviewing-the-audit-log-for-your-organization#searching-the-audit-log).

params.name: include
params.description:
The event types to include:

- `web` - returns web (non-Git) events.
- `git` - returns Git events.
- `all` - returns both web and Git events.

The default is `web`.

params.name: after
params.description: A cursor, as given in the [Link header](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/guides/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api#using-link-headers). If specified, the query only searches for events after this cursor.

params.name: before
params.description: A cursor, as given in the [Link header](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/guides/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api#using-link-headers). If specified, the query only searches for events before this cursor.

params.name: order
params.description:
The order of audit log events. To list newest events first, specify `desc`. To list oldest events first, specify `asc`.

The default is `desc`.

params.name: per_page
params.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."

params.name: page
params.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."

items.docs:
Gets the audit log for an organization. For more information, see "[Reviewing the audit log for your organization](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/github/setting-up-and-managing-organizations-and-teams/reviewing-the-audit-log-for-your-organization)."

By default, the response includes up to 30 events from the past three months. Use the `phrase` parameter to filter results and retrieve older events. For example, use the `phrase` parameter with the `created` qualifier to filter event
